turns.replyText:
Heirloom

Hello! I’m Everett, your virtual guide for product info, plant care, and customer support.

Today
My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?

I’m really glad you reached out, and I’m sorry the box did not arrive in the condition you expected. Thank you for taking the time to check everything over.

So our team can review this and help with next steps, could you please reply with all of the following:

Your full name
The email address used for your order
Your order number (if you have it handy)
The name(s) of the item(s) that appear damaged
A few clear photos, if you are able to provide them:
The outside of the box (including any visible damage)
The item(s) in their packaging
Close-ups of the area(s) you are concerned about

If you are not able to send photos, just let me know and we will still pass along the details you provide.

Once I have that information, I’ll connect you with our garden advisors so they can review your situation and follow up via email. For assistance with this, our team is also here to help by phone at (800) 820-0465, Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM, and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST.
